bottleneck.identified: Morning Briefing PDF pipeline — 8:30 AM run is the single-point-of-failure for TJ's daily activation signal
bottleneck.evidence: 6 consecutive errors. Most recent: timed out at exactly 600s (prior limit). Timeout now 900s — 50% buffer added. But the underlying pipeline (local server boot → browser navigation → PDF render → git push) is consistently slow. The 900s timeout is a band-aid. Root cause is monolithic job design.
bottleneck.urgency: Next run: 8:30 AM CT today — 2.5 hours from now
bottleneck.northStarImpact: Morning Briefing is TJ's primary daily activation trigger. If he doesn't get it, he doesn't execute. At 11/25 customers, every day of inaction costs acquisition velocity. This is not a nice-to-have.
bottleneck.recommendation: Permanent fix: Split into two crons. (1) Content cron: generates briefing HTML + sends email, runs at 8:28 AM, completes in ~90s. (2) PDF cron: local server + browser + render + push, runs at 8:35 AM, completes in ~120s. Never times out. Eliminates this category of failure permanently.
